name: Tech Buzz
description: Questions covering: Artificial Intelligence, Consumer Electronics, Search Engines, Social Media...

questions.question: What is the name of the 1950 proposal by a British mathematician to determine if a computer can exhibit human-like conversation?
questions.explanation_correct: Proposed by Alan Turing, this test evaluates a machine's ability to exhibit intelligent behavior indistinguishable from that of a human.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The Loebner Prize is a competition based on the Turing Test, not the test itself.

questions.question: Which virtual assistant is built into Apple devices?
questions.explanation_correct: Siri is Apple's voice-based virtual assistant integrated into iPhones, iPads, Macs, and other Apple products.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are virtual assistants too, but they are associated with different companies.

questions.question: Which company was founded by Larry Page and Sergey Brin?
questions.explanation_correct: Google was founded by Larry Page and Sergey Brin and became one of the dominant search companies in the world.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are search-related companies or products, but they were not founded by Page and Brin.

questions.question: Which company changed its corporate name to Meta Platforms in 2021?
questions.explanation_correct: Facebook, Inc. changed its corporate name to Meta Platforms, Inc. in 2021; Facebook remains the name of a social network.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Instagram and WhatsApp remain products owned by the parent company now called Meta.

questions.question: Which pseudonym is associated with the inventor of Bitcoin?
questions.explanation_correct: Satoshi Nakamoto is the pseudonym used by the unknown creator of Bitcoin.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are prominent figures in cryptocurrency and cryptography, but they are not the Bitcoin creator's pseudonym.

questions.question: Which car manufacturer is known for producing the Model 3 and Model Y?
questions.explanation_correct: Tesla is the electric vehicle manufacturer behind the Model 3 and Model Y.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are car makers, but they are not the manufacturer of those specific EV models.

questions.question: Which virtual reality company, acquired by Facebook in 2014, pioneered the modern VR era with its crowdfunded headset?
questions.explanation_correct: Oculus VR, co-founded by Palmer Luckey and others, crowdfunded an early Rift developer headset. Facebook acquired Oculus in 2014.
questions.explanation_incorrect: HTC and Valve collaborated on the Vive, whereas PlayStation developed its own ecosystem.

questions.question: What do the initials AWS stand for in cloud computing?
questions.explanation_correct: AWS stands for Amazon Web Services, a cloud computing platform.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other phrases do not expand AWS in this context.

questions.question: Which video meeting platform was founded by Eric Yuan?
questions.explanation_correct: Zoom is a widely used video conferencing platform for meetings, webinars, and online collaboration.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Teams, Meet, and Webex are other video meeting products, associated with Microsoft, Google, and Cisco respectively.

questions.question: Which browser is developed by Google and commonly used on desktop and mobile devices?
questions.explanation_correct: Chrome is Google's web browser and one of the most widely used browsers globally.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are web browsers too, but they are not the Google browser named in the question.

questions.question: Which type of malicious software typically encrypts a victim's files and demands payment?
questions.explanation_correct: Ransomware is malware that locks or encrypts data and extorts payment for restoration. It is a common malicious software type in cybersecurity.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options refer to different kinds of malware or threats that do not primarily use extortion through file encryption.

questions.question: Which company makes the GeForce graphics card family?
questions.explanation_correct: NVIDIA is widely recognized as a leading chip designer, especially for GPUs and AI-related accelerators. Its products are central to modern semiconductors.
questions.explanation_incorrect: AMD makes Radeon graphics products, Intel makes Arc graphics products, and Qualcomm makes Snapdragon chips.

questions.question: Which mobile operating system is developed by Google?
questions.explanation_correct: Android is Google's mobile operating system used on a wide range of smartphones and tablets. It is one of the most widely deployed OS platforms in the world.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are mobile operating systems, but they are from different developers and do not match the clue.

questions.question: Which streaming device line shares its name with the company Roku, Inc.?
questions.explanation_correct: Roku is a device line and platform used for streaming television and media content. It offers dedicated hardware for accessing streaming services.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Fire TV, Chromecast and Apple TV are streaming brands associated with Amazon, Google and Apple.

questions.question: Which blockchain mechanism rewards participants with the ability to validate transactions based on the amount of currency they 'lock up'?
questions.explanation_correct: Proof of stake selects validators using a stake of cryptocurrency, subject to each network’s rules. It generally uses less energy than proof-of-work mining.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Proof of Work relies on computational power and hardware energy consumption.

questions.question: Which OpenAI conversational AI service launched as a public research preview in November 2022?
questions.explanation_correct: ChatGPT is an OpenAI service that provides conversational access to AI models; it is an application, not the name of a single model.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Claude was developed by Anthropic, and Gemini is a Google product.

questions.question: Which smart speaker line is made by Amazon?
questions.explanation_correct: Echo is Amazon's smart speaker line powered by Alexa. It is one of the most recognizable consumer electronics products in that category.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are smart speakers or related products from other companies, but they are not Amazon's line.

questions.question: Which iPhone introduced Siri as an integrated assistant in 2011?
questions.explanation_correct: Apple introduced Siri as a feature of iPhone 4S in 2011.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The iPhone 3G came earlier; the iPhone 5S and iPhone X came later.

questions.question: Which short-video platform owned by ByteDance became globally popular for viral clips and trends?
questions.explanation_correct: TikTok is the short-video platform owned by ByteDance. It is known for viral short-form content and algorithm-driven feeds.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts belong to Meta and Google respectively; Snapchat is operated by Snap.

questions.question: Which blockchain platform uses Ether as its native cryptocurrency?
questions.explanation_correct: Ethereum is the blockchain platform whose native cryptocurrency is Ether. It supports smart contracts and decentralized applications.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are blockchain platforms, but they do not use Ether as their native asset.

questions.question: Which collaboration software, bundled with Microsoft 365, largely replaced Skype for Business in corporate environments?
questions.explanation_correct: Microsoft Teams is a unified communication platform for chat, video meetings, and file storage.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Slack is a primary competitor not owned by Microsoft, and Zoom is primarily focused on video.

questions.question: Which Chinese EV manufacturer founded by William Li is being referred to here?
questions.explanation_correct: NIO is the Chinese electric vehicle manufacturer founded by William Li. It is known for premium EVs and battery-swapping technology.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are also EV-related companies, but they are not the one founded by William Li. Each has a different founder or corporate background.

questions.question: Which CPU and GPU company is known for the Ryzen processor line?
questions.explanation_correct: AMD designs Ryzen CPUs and Radeon GPUs. Chip design and fabrication are distinct activities.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are semiconductor companies or related firms, but they are not the maker of Ryzen. Some focus more on CPUs, GPUs, or chip architecture.

questions.question: What Samsung phone family includes the folding Galaxy Z Fold and Z Flip models?
questions.explanation_correct: Samsung uses the Galaxy Z branding for its foldable phones, including the Fold and Flip models. It is the company's dedicated foldable line.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are Samsung phone families, but they are not the foldable line. They refer to standard flagship, midrange, or legacy devices.

questions.question: What is the name of Amazon’s Fire-branded streaming device and smart TV platform?
questions.explanation_correct: Fire TV is Amazon's streaming device and smart TV platform line. It is used to access streaming apps and content on televisions.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are streaming devices or platforms from different companies. They are not Amazon's TV streaming product line.

questions.question: Which password manager was acquired by LogMeIn in 2015?
questions.explanation_correct: LogMeIn acquired LastPass in 2015. LogMeIn later rebranded as GoTo, and LastPass was subsequently separated as a distinct business.
questions.explanation_incorrect: 1Password, Dashlane and Bitwarden are other password-management products.

questions.question: Which web browser was developed by Mozilla?
questions.explanation_correct: Firefox is the web browser developed by Mozilla. It is one of the major open-source browsers.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are web browsers, but they were developed by different companies. None of them are Mozilla's browser.

questions.question: Which search engine emphasizes privacy and says it does not track users’ searches?
questions.explanation_correct: DuckDuckGo promotes private search and says it does not track users’ searches. Privacy protections vary by service and context.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are search engines too, but they are not primarily known for privacy-focused search. They follow different business models and data practices.

questions.question: What is the name of Microsoft’s cloud computing platform?
questions.explanation_correct: Azure is Microsoft's cloud computing platform. It provides infrastructure, platform, and software services.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are cloud platforms from other companies. They are not Microsoft's cloud service.

questions.question: Which chipmaker is best known for its Snapdragon processors?
questions.explanation_correct: Qualcomm is the chipmaker known for Snapdragon processors and mobile chipsets. Its products are widely used in smartphones and other devices.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are semiconductor companies, but they are not the one associated with Snapdragon. They focus on different chip categories or product lines.

questions.question: Which research lab is known for developing ChatGPT?
questions.explanation_correct: OpenAI is the research lab behind ChatGPT and several other widely used AI models. It is a major name in artificial intelligence research and deployment.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are also AI-related organizations, but they are not the lab most directly associated with ChatGPT.

questions.question: Which headset brand is commonly associated with HTC's virtual reality line?
questions.explanation_correct: Vive is HTC's well-known virtual reality headset brand. It has been a prominent name in consumer and enterprise VR.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are VR headset brands too, but they are not the HTC lineup named in the question.

questions.question: Which automaker introduced the R1T electric pickup and R1S electric SUV?
questions.explanation_correct: Rivian is an electric automaker known for the R1T and R1S. It focuses on adventure-oriented EVs.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are electric-vehicle brands, but they are not the company described by the question.

questions.question: Which company makes the Intel Core family of x86 processors?
questions.explanation_correct: Intel makes the Core processor family and has a long history in x86 computing.
questions.explanation_incorrect: AMD also makes x86 processors, but Intel Core is Intel’s brand. NVIDIA and Qualcomm produce other chip families.

questions.question: Which social app operated by Snap Inc. is known for disappearing messages and AR lenses?
questions.explanation_correct: Snapchat is recognized for ephemeral messaging and its early use of AR lenses. It is a major social app with a distinct messaging style.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are social platforms too, but they are not the one best known for disappearing snaps.

questions.question: Which smartphone line is produced by Apple?
questions.explanation_correct: The iPhone is Apple's flagship smartphone line. It has been one of the most influential phones since its introduction in 2007.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are all smartphone lines, but they are not Apple’s product line.

questions.question: What was the name of Google’s streaming dongle introduced in 2013 for playing online media on a TV?
questions.explanation_correct: Chromecast is Google's streaming dongle brand used to cast content to televisions. It became widely known for simple app-based streaming.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Roku and Fire TV are streaming brands from other companies; AirPlay is an Apple wireless streaming technology.

questions.question: Which cloud computing platform is known for its developer-friendly virtual servers called Droplets?
questions.explanation_correct: DigitalOcean is a cloud platform popular with developers for simple infrastructure and Droplets. It is known for a more streamlined experience than larger hyperscalers.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are cloud platforms too, but they are not the provider associated with Droplets.

questions.question: Which online meeting product did Cisco acquire when it bought its namesake company in 2007?
questions.explanation_correct: Webex began as a separate company and became part of Cisco following its 2007 acquisition.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are also meeting platforms, but they are not the Cisco product referenced here.

questions.question: Which consensus mechanism secures Bitcoin by requiring miners to solve computational puzzles?
questions.explanation_correct: Proof of work is the consensus mechanism used by Bitcoin and several other cryptocurrencies. It relies on miners performing computational work to validate blocks.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are real consensus mechanisms, but they do not match the mining-based system described.

questions.question: Which password manager has the numeral 1 at the start of its name?
questions.explanation_correct: 1Password reflects the goal of remembering a single master password to access an entire vault of credentials.
questions.explanation_incorrect: LastPass, Bitwarden and Dashlane are other password managers. The name 1Password explicitly includes the number one.

questions.question: Which Apple speaker line is designed for music playback and smart assistant features?
questions.explanation_correct: HomePod is Apple's smart speaker line. It combines audio playback with Siri-based voice control.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are smart speakers too, but they are made by different companies.

questions.question: Which automaker is known for the Air sedan and the Gravity SUV?
questions.explanation_correct: Lucid is the automaker behind the Air sedan and Gravity SUV.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are electric vehicle companies, but they are not the one associated with the Air sedan.

questions.question: Which web browser is made by Apple and included with macOS and iOS?
questions.explanation_correct: Safari is Apple’s browser and is included with macOS and iOS; users can select a different default browser.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are web browsers too, but they are not Apple's default browser.

questions.question: Which chip family is commonly associated with Qualcomm mobile processors?
questions.explanation_correct: Snapdragon is Qualcomm's family of mobile processors and system-on-chips. It is widely used in smartphones and other mobile devices.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are also mobile chip families, but they are associated with different semiconductor companies.

questions.question: What is the general term for AI methods that learn patterns from data?
questions.explanation_correct: Machine learning is a foundational concept in artificial intelligence. It involves training systems to learn patterns from data.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Cryptography protects information; networking connects systems; indexing helps organize and retrieve data.

questions.question: What term is used for a distributed record in blockchain systems?
questions.explanation_correct: A ledger is the record-keeping component in a blockchain. It tracks transactions across the network in a distributed way.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are blockchain-related terms, but they refer to different components or concepts.

questions.question: What tactic involves tricking users into revealing credentials through deceptive messages?
questions.explanation_correct: Phishing uses deceptive emails, texts, or sites to steal sensitive information. It relies on social engineering rather than technical exploitation alone.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are cyberattack terms, but they describe different methods or malware types.

questions.question: Which term refers to small wireless audio devices worn in the ears?
questions.explanation_correct: Earbuds are compact audio devices designed to fit in or just outside the ear. Many modern models are wireless and use Bluetooth.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are audio hardware too, but they describe larger or different types of devices.

questions.question: What does CCS stand for in the context of EV charging?
questions.explanation_correct: CCS means Combined Charging System, a family of connectors combining AC and DC charging arrangements.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other phrases are not what the CCS abbreviation stands for.

questions.question: What is Instagram’s short-form video feature called?
questions.explanation_correct: Reels is Instagram's short-form vertical video format. It is designed for quick, shareable clips.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Stories can also contain vertical video, but Reels is the name of Instagram’s dedicated short-form video feature.

questions.question: Which open-source system orchestrates containerized applications across clusters?
questions.explanation_correct: Kubernetes orchestrates containers across clusters, including deployment and scaling. It is not itself a cloud provider.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are related tools or platforms, but they are not the primary container orchestration system named here.

questions.question: What term describes the motion sickness-like symptoms some users experience in virtual reality?
questions.explanation_correct: Cybersickness is the term for nausea or discomfort caused by VR experiences. It is analogous to motion sickness.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options refer to technical issues or visual artifacts, not the user symptom itself.

questions.question: Which processor architecture is designed by Arm and used in many phones?
questions.explanation_correct: ARM is a widely used processor architecture, especially in mobile devices and embedded systems. It is known for efficiency and low power use.
questions.explanation_incorrect: x86, RISC-V and MIPS are other instruction-set architectures.

questions.question: What web indexing file standard helps search engines discover pages on a site?
questions.explanation_correct: A sitemap can list URLs and metadata to help search engines discover pages. Inclusion does not guarantee that a page will be indexed.
questions.explanation_incorrect: A robots.txt file communicates crawler rules and can point to a sitemap; it is not itself the usual page-by-page URL list.

questions.question: Which smart-home interoperability standard was developed as Project Connected Home over IP (CHIP)?
questions.explanation_correct: The Connectivity Standards Alliance renamed Project CHIP to Matter; the standard aims to help smart-home devices work together.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Zigbee, Z-Wave and Thread are also relevant to device connectivity. Matter is the standard named in the question.

questions.question: Which streaming service is best known for helping popularize binge-release viewing of entire seasons at once?
questions.explanation_correct: Netflix became famous for releasing full seasons of many shows at once. That model helped define modern binge-watching.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are streaming services too, but they are not the one most associated with this release strategy.

questions.question: Which sensor technology uses laser-based distance measurement and is widely used in autonomous driving?
questions.explanation_correct: LiDAR measures distance using laser light and creates detailed 3D maps of surroundings. It is a key sensor in many autonomous systems.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are different sensing technologies or motion sensors, not the laser-based mapping system asked for.

questions.question: Which cryptocurrency was introduced in the 2008 white paper attributed to Satoshi Nakamoto?
questions.explanation_correct: Bitcoin was described in a 2008 white paper under the pseudonym Satoshi Nakamoto and launched in 2009.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Ethereum, Litecoin and Dogecoin are later cryptocurrency projects.

questions.question: Which generative AI image synthesis model type works by gradually denoising random inputs into pictures?
questions.explanation_correct: Many diffusion image generators learn to reverse a gradual noising process, starting from noise and iteratively generating an image.
questions.explanation_incorrect: A diffusion system can incorporate other architectures, including transformers. GANs are another family of generative models.

questions.question: Which foundational model architecture became central to modern natural language processing?
questions.explanation_correct: The transformer architecture uses attention mechanisms and became a foundation for many modern language models. Attention mechanisms also existed before transformers.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Recurrent networks, perceptrons and decision trees are other model families.

questions.question: Which secure website protocol is used to encrypt data between a browser and a server?
questions.explanation_correct: HTTPS is HTTP layered over TLS to protect web traffic in transit.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are different network protocols with different purposes. They are not the standard encrypted web protocol.

questions.question: Which short-range wireless standard, managed by the Bluetooth SIG, is widely used for headphones?
questions.explanation_correct: Bluetooth is the short-range wireless standard widely used for consumer audio devices.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are wireless technologies or streaming systems, but they are not the common device-to-device audio standard. They do not best fit typical wireless headphone pairing.

questions.question: What is the abbreviation for the North American Charging System associated with SAE J3400?
questions.explanation_correct: NACS stands for North American Charging System; SAE J3400 specifies a related charging coupler system.
questions.explanation_incorrect: CCS, CHAdeMO and GB/T are different charging systems or standards.

questions.question: What is the name of the fifth generation of cellular networking?
questions.explanation_correct: 5G denotes the fifth generation of cellular networking. Actual speed and latency depend on the network, device and conditions.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are earlier cellular generations or related networking terms. They do not refer to the current generation brand in the prompt.

questions.question: Which social platform launched as a photo-sharing app and later introduced Reels?
questions.explanation_correct: Instagram features short-form video through Reels and originated as a photo-sharing platform.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are social or video platforms, but they are not the service described here. They do not match the platform’s history and format as closely.

questions.question: Which company created the Docker container platform?
questions.explanation_correct: Docker popularized application containers and the tooling around them.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are related to cloud infrastructure or virtualization, but they are not the container software company referenced. They do not match the named platform.

questions.question: What does the abbreviation TSMC stand for?
questions.explanation_correct: TSMC stands for Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company, a semiconductor foundry.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other expansions are not the company’s name.

questions.question: What broad term commonly means a cryptocurrency other than Bitcoin?
questions.explanation_correct: Altcoin commonly refers to a cryptocurrency other than Bitcoin; some categories of altcoin overlap with stablecoins or meme coins.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Stablecoins and meme coins describe other properties or categories and can also be altcoins.

questions.question: Which wireless smart-home standard shares its name with the industry group formerly known as the Zigbee Alliance?
questions.explanation_correct: Zigbee is a low-power wireless technology; the Zigbee Alliance became the Connectivity Standards Alliance in 2021.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Z-Wave and Thread are also low-power wireless technologies; Matter is an application-layer interoperability standard.

questions.question: Which Microsoft search engine introduced an AI chat feature based on OpenAI technology in 2023?
questions.explanation_correct: Microsoft introduced the AI-powered Bing chat experience in 2023 using a model from OpenAI.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Google, DuckDuckGo and Yahoo are other search services; Bing is Microsoft’s search engine.

questions.question: What is the name of Apple's flagship spatial computing device released in 2024?
questions.explanation_correct: The Apple Vision Pro is a high-end headset merging digital content with the physical world.
questions.explanation_incorrect: HoloLens 2 is a Microsoft enterprise product, while Meta Quest 3 is a consumer headset.

questions.question: Which productivity tool is best known for its 'all-in-one' workspace featuring blocks, databases, and markdown support?
questions.explanation_correct: Notion is highly flexible software used for note-taking, project management, and personal organization.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Trello is primarily a Kanban-style board tool, and Asana focuses more on task management.

questions.question: Which engineering company is famous for viral videos of its agile robots, such as the quadruped 'Spot' and the biped 'Atlas'?
questions.explanation_correct: Boston Dynamics is a global leader in designing robots with advanced mobility and dexterity.
questions.explanation_incorrect: iRobot is best known for the Roomba vacuum cleaner, not advanced humanoids.

questions.question: Which Swedish fintech company offers buy-now-pay-later services?
questions.explanation_correct: Klarna offers buy-now-pay-later products; interest and fees depend on the product, country, and terms.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Affirm is an American competitor, and Afterpay was founded in Australia.

questions.question: What is the common acronym for the security challenge that requires users to identify images or type distorted text to prove they are not bots?
questions.explanation_correct: It stands for 'Completely Automated Public Turing test to tell Computers and Humans Apart'.
questions.explanation_incorrect: A firewall is a network security system, and encryption is a method of encoding data.

questions.question: Which Amazon e-reader was introduced in 2007?
questions.explanation_correct: Amazon introduced the Kindle e-reader in 2007; Kindle devices typically use electronic-paper displays.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Nook and Kobo are other e-reader brands; the iPad is an Apple tablet.

questions.question: Which browser is developed by Opera and is known for features including a built-in browser VPN?
questions.explanation_correct: Opera includes a built-in browser VPN; its availability and scope depend on the product and settings.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Firefox, Chrome and Edge are different browsers and are not developed by Opera.

questions.question: Which premium electric car manufacturer originated as a racing team and performance sub-brand for Volvo?
questions.explanation_correct: Polestar has roots in motorsport and Volvo performance cars and later became a standalone electric performance car brand.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Lucid and Rivian are separate car companies; Volvo was historically associated with Polestar.

questions.question: Which category of malicious software is designed specifically to gather data about a user without their consent and transmit it to a third party?
questions.explanation_correct: Spyware secretly gathers information about a user or device; its specific behaviors and destinations vary.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Ransomware extorts payment, often by encrypting files; adware primarily displays unwanted advertisements.

questions.question: Which short-form social platform is known for prompting users to post once per day at a random time?
questions.explanation_correct: BeReal is the short-form social platform built around a daily random posting prompt. It became known for encouraging spontaneous, unedited sharing.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are social platforms, but they are not the same daily-prompt app. They focus on different formats such as video, stories, or messaging.

questions.question: Which platform is known for running apps in isolated containers called dynos?
questions.explanation_correct: Heroku is a platform for deploying and running apps in managed containers called dynos.
questions.explanation_incorrect: AWS Lambda, Docker and Vercel offer different tools or hosting services.

questions.question: Which semiconductor and software company makes the networking chip family called Tomahawk?
questions.explanation_correct: Broadcom produces Tomahawk Ethernet switch chips used in networking equipment.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Qualcomm, NVIDIA and Intel make other semiconductor products; Tomahawk Ethernet switch chips are a Broadcom family.

questions.question: Which brand launched the Nest Learning Thermostat?
questions.explanation_correct: The Nest Learning Thermostat is a smart thermostat first introduced by Nest.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Ecobee and Hive also make smart thermostats; Ring is another connected-device brand.

questions.question: What is Sony’s virtual-reality headset family for PlayStation consoles called?
questions.explanation_correct: PlayStation VR is Sony’s headset family. The original headset and PlayStation VR2 have different console compatibility.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Meta Quest, Valve Index and HTC Vive are headset families from other companies.

questions.question: Which blockchain platform is known for high-throughput transactions and a proof-of-history design?
questions.explanation_correct: Solana is a blockchain platform designed for fast transaction processing and high throughput. It is known for using proof of history as part of its architecture.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Ethereum, Cardano and Polkadot have different blockchain designs; Solana is associated with proof of history.

questions.question: Which messaging app is developed by the nonprofit Signal Foundation and uses end-to-end encryption?
questions.explanation_correct: Signal is an encrypted messaging app widely recognized for privacy and security. It uses end-to-end encryption and is developed as an open-source project.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Telegram, WhatsApp and iMessage are operated by other organizations and have different designs and settings.

questions.question: Which search engine is known for prioritizing privacy while routing results through Google anonymously?
questions.explanation_correct: Startpage is a privacy-focused search engine that serves results while reducing user tracking. It is known for providing Google search results with extra privacy protections.
questions.explanation_incorrect: DuckDuckGo, Ecosia and Qwant are separate search services with different providers and privacy practices.

questions.question: Which Linux distribution is widely used for desktops and servers and is developed by Canonical?
questions.explanation_correct: Ubuntu is a Linux distribution developed by Canonical and used broadly on desktops, servers, and cloud systems. It is one of the most recognized Linux distros.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Debian, Fedora and Arch Linux are other Linux distributions; Ubuntu is developed by Canonical and its community.

questions.question: Which service, launched in 2003, became known for internet voice and video calls under Microsoft ownership?
questions.explanation_correct: Skype launched in 2003 and became a widely used internet calling service. Microsoft acquired it in 2011; consumer Skype was retired in 2025.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Google Meet are separate meeting products.

questions.question: What is the name of the search engine associated with the Brave browser?
questions.explanation_correct: Brave Search is a search engine associated with Brave and uses an independently built search index.
questions.explanation_incorrect: DuckDuckGo, Startpage and Qwant are separate search engines.

questions.question: What was the name of Google’s first foldable Pixel smartphone, released in 2023?
questions.explanation_correct: Google released the Pixel Fold in 2023. Subsequent Google foldables may use different Pixel names.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are foldable or dual-screen phones from other brands. They do not refer to Google’s Pixel Fold line.

questions.question: Which AI chatbot is created by Anthropic?
questions.explanation_correct: Claude is an AI assistant developed by Anthropic.
questions.explanation_incorrect: ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity are AI products associated with other companies.

questions.question: Which Chinese automaker uses the slogan “Build Your Dreams” and makes the Dolphin EV?
questions.explanation_correct: BYD uses “Build Your Dreams” and makes the Dolphin electric car.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Tesla, Rivian and Lucid are US-based automakers; BYD originated in China.

questions.question: What is YouTube’s short-form vertical video feature called?
questions.explanation_correct: YouTube Shorts is YouTube’s short-form video feature.
questions.explanation_incorrect: TikTok, Instagram Reels and Snapchat Spotlight are other short-form video services or features.

questions.question: Which streaming hardware was released by the company founded by Steve Jobs and Steve Wozniak?
questions.explanation_correct: Apple TV was first released in 2007 to allow users to stream content from iTunes to their televisions.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Roku, Amazon, and Google are the manufacturers of the other listed streaming devices.

questions.question: Which open-source password manager was founded by Kyle Spearrin?
questions.explanation_correct: Kyle Spearrin founded Bitwarden, a password manager with publicly available source code.
questions.explanation_incorrect: 1Password, LastPass and Dashlane are other password managers.

questions.question: What mixed-reality headset family did Microsoft introduce in 2015?
questions.explanation_correct: Microsoft introduced the HoloLens mixed-reality headset in 2015.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Meta Quest, Magic Leap and Vive XR are headset families from other companies.

questions.question: Which NVIDIA graphics brand is used for its gaming GPUs?
questions.explanation_correct: GeForce is NVIDIA’s graphics product family, including gaming GPUs.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Radeon and Ryzen are AMD brands, while Arc is an Intel graphics brand.

questions.question: Which encrypted messaging app is owned by Meta?
questions.explanation_correct: WhatsApp is a messaging service owned by Meta that uses end-to-end encryption for personal messages and calls.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Signal, Telegram and Viber are messaging services operated by other organizations.
